a_zh: 建议提前 7-14 天预约，节假日建议提前 3-4 周。若是临时需求也可留言，我们会尽量协调。
a_en: We recommend 7-14 days in advance, and 3-4 weeks for holidays. Last-minute requests are still welcome.

q_zh: 首次寄养前可以试住吗？
a_zh: 可以。首次建议先做短时试住或视频沟通，帮助猫咪和家长都更安心。
q_en: Can we do a trial stay?
a_en: Yes. We encourage a short trial stay or pre-boarding call for first-time guests.

a_zh: 默认每天至少 1 次完整更新（照片/视频 + 饮食排泄记录），有异常会即时联系。
q_en: How often do you send updates?
a_en: At least one detailed update daily with photos/videos and care logs.

a_zh: 支持常规口服药及简单护理；注射类或高风险医疗请提前说明并评估可行性。
a_en: Yes for routine oral meds and basic care. Advanced medical cases require prior assessment.

q_zh: 猫咪会和其他猫混养吗？
a_zh: 会根据猫咪性格与家庭来源安排，优先保证安全与压力管理，必要时分区照护。
q_en: Will my cat be mixed with other cats?
a_en: Only when temperament and safety allow. Separate zones are used when needed.

a_zh: 发现异常会第一时间联系家长，并按预先确认的医院与授权流程处理。
a_en: We contact owners immediately and follow the pre-approved clinic/authorization plan.

a_zh: 提供有限区域接送协助，具体时间和费用按当日交通与排班确认。
a_en: Yes in selected areas, subject to schedule and route availability.

q_zh: 取消或改期规则是什么？
a_zh: 入住前 72 小时外取消通常可全额退；72 小时内按预留时间收取部分费用。
a_en: Full refund is usually available before 72 hours. Within 72 hours, partial fees may apply.

a_zh: 建议携带主粮、零食、常用药、熟悉玩具/毯子；我们提供豆腐猫砂和猫砂盆，基础餐具可按需提供；如猫咪习惯木头猫砂请自带。
q_en: What should I bring for boarding?
a_en: Please bring food, treats, meds, and familiar comfort items. We provide tofu litter and a litter box, plus basic bowls if needed. If your cat only uses wood litter, please bring your own.

a_zh: 以 Downtown Vancouver 为核心，覆盖 Burnaby、Richmond 部分区域。
q_en: What service areas do you cover?
a_en: Primary area is Downtown Vancouver, with parts of Burnaby and Richmond.

a_zh: 同家庭多猫可按时长与照护复杂度提供组合报价。
a_en: Yes, bundled rates are available depending on stay length and care complexity.

a_zh: 工作时段通常 1-3 小时内回复；夜间留言会在次日尽快回复。
a_en: Usually within 1-3 hours during service hours, and next morning for late messages.
